title: Day 797: Two Killed, One Wounded in Predawn Attack on Gathering in Montesierra, Culiacán
detail: At around 1:00 AM on Sunday, September 27, 2026, three men gathered for drinks in front of a residence at the corner of Calle Ajusco and Los Alpes, in the Ampliación Montesierra sector of north Culiacán, were attacked with gunfire. A man identified as Rosario died at the scene; a second victim, Rubén Alonso 'N', 28, from the Otatillos community, died later at the hospital. The third man was wounded and remained under medical care, not officially identified as of the report. The State Fiscalía General opened an investigation; the same location saw a similar deadly attack in May 2026.

title: Day 797: Federal Offensive Nets 21 Detentions Across Chapitos and Mayiza Cells in a Week of Mazatlán-Area Operations
detail: Reporting published September 27, 2026 tallied a week of federal, state and Navy operations (September 19-25) against both Sinaloa Cartel factions in and around Mazatlán, resulting in 21 total detentions. Among those captured: Erik Samuel Barraza Sánchez, alias 'El Fantasma,' identified as a La Mayiza local cell leader, and José Luis Ibarra Gutiérrez, alias 'El Prieto,' identified as a Los Chapitos member. A separate seizure south of Culiacán, at El Diez, recovered 49 tonnes of solid chemical substances and 45,490 liters of liquid precursor chemicals. Across the week's operations authorities reported seizing more than 40 firearms, roughly 2,500 rounds of ammunition, 40 improvised explosive devices, 415 fentanyl pills and six vehicles, one of them improvised with makeshift armor. SSPC, Navy (Semar), FGR, the Defense Secretariat and the National Intelligence Center were credited with the operations.
